description: This file provides utility functions and classes for handling user-specific configuration data (userdata), including parsing, type conversion, and namespace management.

classes.name: UserData
classes.description: A dictionary-like class for managing user data with type conversion features.

classes.name: UserDataNamespace
classes.description: A class providing a namespace view over user data, allowing access to parameters with a common prefix.

methods.name: parse_user_define
methods.description: Parses a string of the form '{name}={value}' or a flag, returning a tuple of name and value.

methods.name: unqote
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a string if present.
